description: I am Patuakhali NASA Dreamer from Dhulia, Bauphal. Solo participant - Class 9 student. Our project Patuakhali to Mars is about building sustainable human habitat on Mars using Sun Gun mirrors and Magnetic Shield. We want to show how a small town dream can reach Mars.
summary: Project Patuakhali is a space science learning project made by a student from Patuakhali, Bangladesh. It explores four worlds: Moon, Mars, Venus, and Titan. The project explains how humans can survive, build bases, and explore these worlds in the future. It uses simple science, beautiful visuals, and creative ideas to make space easy to understand for everyone. This project is important because it inspires students from small towns to dream big and join global space missions like NASA Space Apps Challenge.
details: Project Patuakhali shows how we can explore Moon, Mars, Venus and Titan. It describes the surface, weather, and challenges of each world. It shows ideas for moon base, Mars city, Venus floating station, and Titan exploration. It also talks about how humans can live there with oxygen, food, water and energy. I used Google Docs, Canva and mobile phone to create this project. I did not use any coding, I used research, imagination and design. My project is creative because it connects real NASA science with the dream of a student from Patuakhali. I considered safety, cost, and future technology.
